integrantes: Fernando Dorneles da Silva · Enzo Augusto Mucha Domingues · Gabriel Mazui Azevedo · Eduardo Jacques Pereira · Lucas Lima Mendes
texto_escala: VIIRS counts rescaled to MODIS units with a factor measured in the 2012–2025 overlap (1 VIIRS ≈ 0.25 MODIS detections). FRP is the physical cross-check.
texto_formula_n:
N = ½ (N_MODIS + k · N_VIIRS)
k = 0.25, measured in the 2012–2025 overlap
destaque_rotulo: the usual activity in the week of 12–18 Nov 2025, when the rains should have started (Z = 9.3)
destaque_2: No jump at the sensor change: 26.7k detections/yr in 2003–2011, 23.0k/yr in 2013–2021
